description: The filter associated with a deductively closed propositional theory is proper exactly when the theory is consistent.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.filterOfTheory_proper.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α)
  (hT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsClosed T) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.IsProperFilter
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.filterOfTheory T hT) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.TheoryConsistent T
